```{r}
# Load in Libraries
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(terra)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(tmap)
```

```{r}
# Read in OHI region boundaries
ohi_regions <- st_read(here("spatial", "ohi_regions", "goc_ohi_rgns.shp")) |>
  st_make_valid()
```

```{r}
# Create 20 km buffer (run once)
sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)

ohi_regions_marine <- ohi_regions |>
  filter(location == "marine") |>
  st_union()

# Make a buffer ring
buffer_outer <- st_buffer(ohi_regions_marine, dist = 20000)
buffer_ring  <- st_difference(buffer_outer, ohi_regions_marine) |>
  st_make_valid()

# Union it to the marine OHI layer
ohi_marine_plus_20km <- st_union(ohi_regions_marine, buffer_ring)
```

```{r}
# Helper to read one year from new Science mangrove data
read_cgmd_year <- function(year) {
  st_read(here(
    paste0(
      "/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/new_mangroves_data/projected_",
      year,
      "/projected_",
      year,
      ".shp"
    )
  )) |>
    st_make_valid() |>
    st_transform(st_crs(ohi_regions))
}

cgmd_1996 <- read_cgmd_year(1996)
cgmd_2010 <- read_cgmd_year(2010)
cgmd_2020 <- read_cgmd_year(2020)
cgmd_2023 <- read_cgmd_year(2023)
```

```{r}
# Quick map check
cgmd_2023_plot <- st_intersection(cgmd_2023, ohi_regions)

tmap_mode("view")

tm_shape(cgmd_2023_plot) +
  tm_polygons(col = "darkgreen", border.col = "darkgreen", lwd = 0.5) +
  tm_shape(ohi_marine_plus_20km) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "lightblue",
    border.col = "lightblue",
    lwd = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.2
  )
```


```{r}
# Clip to buffer, then sum mangrove area by OHI region
calc_mangrove_area_by_region <- function(mangrove_layer, year) {
  mangrove_layer |>
    st_intersection(ohi_marine_plus_20km) |>
    st_intersection(ohi_regions) |>
    group_by(rgn_id) |>
    summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(
      area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1e6,
      year = year
    ) |>
    st_drop_geometry()
}
```

## CONDITION — CGMD 1996 vs 2020
```{r}
rgns_cgmd_1996 <- calc_mangrove_area_by_region(cgmd_1996, 1996)
rgns_cgmd_2010 <- calc_mangrove_area_by_region(cgmd_2010, 2010)
rgns_cgmd_2020 <- calc_mangrove_area_by_region(cgmd_2020, 2020)
rgns_cgmd_2023 <- calc_mangrove_area_by_region(cgmd_2023, 2023)

cgmd_area <- bind_rows(
  rgns_cgmd_1996,
  rgns_cgmd_2010,
  rgns_cgmd_2020,
  rgns_cgmd_2023
) |>
  group_by(rgn_id, year) |>
  summarise(area_km2 = sum(area_km2), .groups = "drop")

mangrove_condition <- cgmd_area |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = area_km2) |>
  mutate(
    condition = `2020` / `1996`,
    condition = pmin(condition, 1),
    year = 2020
  ) |>
  select(rgn_id, year, condition)
```

```{r}
mangrove_condition |>
  filter(!rgn_id %in% c("Region_2", "Region_3")) |>
  kable(
    digits = 4,
    col.names = c("Region", "Year", "Condition (2020/1996)")
  ) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered")) |>
  add_header_above(c("Mangrove Condition (CGMD)" = 3))
```


## EXTENT — CGMD 2023
```{r}
rgns_cgmd_2023_extent <- rgns_cgmd_2023

rgns_cgmd_2023_extent |>
    filter(!rgn_id %in% c("Region_2", "Region_3")) |>
  kable(
    digits = 4,
    col.names = c("Region", "Extent (km²)", "Year")
  ) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered")) |>
  add_header_above(c("Mangrove Extent (CGMD)" = 3))
```


## TREND — CGMD 2010 → 2020
```{r}
mangrove_trend <- cgmd_area |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = area_km2) |>
  mutate(
    trend = (`2020` / `2010`)^(1 / 10) - 1,
    year = 2020
  ) |>
  select(rgn_id, year, trend)
```


```{r}
cgmd_area |>
  filter(year %in% c(1996, 2010, 2020)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = area_km2) |>
  arrange(rgn_id) |>
  kable(
    digits = 2,
    col.names = c("Region", "1996 (km²)", "2010 (km²)", "2020 (km²)"),
    caption = "Mangrove extent by region (CGMD)"
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered", "hover"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "left"
  )
```
